description: Trovaprezzi helps users find purchasable physical products, compare current prices and offers, and open relevant Trovaprezzi listings from a carousel widget inside ChatGPT. The app supports shopping-oriented searches for specific models, variants, availability, and budget-filtered product discovery while avoiding purely informational or non-shopping requests.
